headline: Granted Certificate of Appropriateness for exterior renovations at 192 Bates Street, 6-0.
summary: The board reviewed an application for a Certificate of Appropriateness for exterior renovations at 192 Bates Street and approved it 6-0. The board also discussed plans for the upcoming HBRB Awards Ceremony on August 6, 2026, and approved the June 4, 2026 minutes 6-0.
decisions: Granted a Certificate of Appropriateness for exterior renovations at 192 Bates Street, as described in the application submitted by Jim Wu, by a vote of 6-0.
Approved the June 4, 2026 meeting minutes as presented, 6-0.

plain_text:
CITY OF LEWISTON 
HISTORIC PRESERVATION REVIEW BOARD MEETING 
FINAL MINUTES for Thursday July 9, 2026 
 
I. Roll Call:  This meeting was called to order at 3:00 pm and Mark Lee chaired the 
meeting. 
 
Members Present:  Mark Lee, Margaret Craven, Nicole Lemieux, Caitlin 
Lampman, James “Pat” Webber and Andie Moss-Weaver 
 
Members Absent:  James Lysen      
 
Associate Member Absent: Roger Phillipon and Nimo Moussa 
 
Staff Present:  Craig Thibeault, Land Use Planner   
 
Applicants Present:  Jim Wu, Owner and Maria Morrisette   
 
II.  CORRESPONDENCE:  None 
 
III.  APPLICATIONS FOR REVIEW: 
 
A.  Application for a Certificate of Appropriateness for exterior renovations at 
     192 Bates Street.  
 
Jim Wu, Owner, wrote a statement regarding the proposed project and    
Maria Morrisette read it to the board.  
 
Craig Thibeault gave a brief overview of the project and informed the 
board the application was complete. Lee inquired about any other material 
changes to the exterior. A brief discussion took place regarding railing 
color which wasn’t noted in the plans. Wu notified the board the roof was 
re-flashed as the rubber membrane was incorrectly done.   
 
        The following motion was made: 
                      MOTION:  by Craven pursuant to Article XV, Section 5 to grant a 
Certificate of Appropriateness for exterior renovations at 192 
Bates Street, as described in the application submitted by 
Jim Wu.   
                       Second by Lampman.  
  VOTED: 6-0 (Passed) 
  
IV.       UPDATE FROM THE PUBLIC ARTS COMMITTEE: 
 
 Thibeault explained that a copy of the June 8, 2026, Public Arts Committee 
agenda was provided in the packet. 
 
V. OTHER BUSINESS:  
 
 Thibeault briefed the board on the upcoming HBRB Awards Ceremony 
scheduled for August 6, 2026. He notified the board of the following:
